Opening

We’ve built something special.
The next part is harder.

We’ve grown fast and built something to be proud of. We’re also at a turning point, and will need to make some rather large pivots to continue our success.

Why Now

We’re at an inflection point

Five years of fast growth have leveled off — and this year we’re sliding back. That forces us to take a hard look at every part of how we work.

01

People are the lever

People and people strategy are priority number one from here.

02

Scale multiplies everything

As we add people, every standard, habit, and decision compounds — the good and the bad.

03

The bar is getting higher

What was good enough won’t be — for the work, and for how we get it done.

04

Culture is how we turn it around

We believe our team and how we operate is the biggest lever we have for the next chapter.

Part One · Core Values

What we believe and expect of each other

Jones Road
04
1

Do Great Work

We’re not here to be average. Hold yourself and others to high standards. Don’t settle for less than you are capable of.

1

Do Great Work

This Looks Like

  • —Holding yourself and others to a high standard — and doing your best work.
  • —Being pushed and stretched outside your comfort zone.
  • —Refusing to accept mediocre work just to avoid an awkward conversation.

This Is Not

Burning out or working around the clock. Backseat-managing, nitpicking, or perfectionism.

Jones Road
06
2

Own the Outcome

You are responsible for your results. Take pride in your work. Take initiative, remove obstacles, and follow through to completion.

2

Own the Outcome

This Looks Like

  • —Owning the outcome of your role — not just the inputs — and seeing it through.
  • —A do-whatever-it-takes mentality: when something’s off track, you speak up, adapt, and get the support you need.
  • —Acting like the CEO of your domain — you’re responsible for making it happen.

This Is Not

Blaming others or making excuses when something goes wrong.

Jones Road
08
3

Stay Hungry

Be curious, passionate, and eager to learn and grow.

3

Stay Hungry

This Looks Like

  • —A growth mindset — constantly improving in everything you do.
  • —Curiosity and passion — wanting to stretch yourself and try new things.
  • —Taking on more, staying humble, and always learning and growing.

This Is Not

Thinking you already have it all figured out — the hungriest people ask the most questions, not answer them.

Jones Road
10
4

Win Together

We hold each other accountable for the greater good. Hard, direct conversations are kind, respectful, and lead to better outcomes. Put the team before yourself, and don’t be a jerk.

4

Win Together

This Looks Like

  • —Supporting your teammates and shouting each other out — and holding each other accountable so we actually win.
  • —Doing the hard thing the kind, direct way — real feedback that makes us better.
  • —Having hard conversations face to face — straight to your manager or peer, not around them.

This Is Not

An overly nice, conflict-avoidant culture — going around people, or to HR, instead of talking to them directly.

Jones Road

Part Two · Operating Principles

Values tell us who we are.
Principles tell us how we work.

Jones Road
13
Operating Principles

How we show up & do the work

01

Bias for Action

Speed is our competitive advantage. Make decisions fast, set tight deadlines, get it out the door.

02

Use Leverage

Pick the things that move the needle, then find the smartest ways to do them. AI, automation, ruthless prioritization.

03

Default to AI First

AI first, always. It’s how we move faster, improve output, and outwork bigger teams. Non-optional.

04

Communicate Clearly

Default to over-communication. Share context generously but concisely. Never hold onto concerns — only good news can wait.

05

Respect Others’ Time

You own your calendar. Limit meetings, always have an agenda, keep attendance tight, share notes freely.

06

Everyone Produces

No spectators. Regardless of title or tenure, everyone gets their hands dirty. No task is beneath anyone.

07

Customer Service Is Everyone’s Job

Be customer obsessed. Read reviews, work in the store, use insights for your role, and put the customer first.

Jones Road
14
What This Means

These matter in tangible ways

01

Hiring

We hire for values alignment, not just skill. Culture fit is a real part of the decision.

02

Onboarding

New hires learn these first. They’re the foundation, not the fine print.

03

Performance Reviews

How you work matters alongside what you produce. Both are evaluated.

04

Promotions & Leveling

Strong results and values-aligned behavior — both required. One without the other isn’t enough.

05

Recognition

How we celebrate people, and how we part ways, reflects these values too.
